data.title: Crisis-hit Flavio Bolsonaro launches presidential candidacy in Brazil
data.description: SAO PAULO - Battered by a string of political crises, Flavio Bolsonaro on Saturday prepared to formally launch his candidacy for Brazil's October presidential election, seeking to follow in the footsteps of his father, Jair Bolsonaro.

data.title: Thousands shelter from devastating fires in Bordeaux
data.description: BORDEAUX, France - Amid rows of camp beds and stacks of food supplies at a makeshift shelter in Bordeaux, thousands of tourists and locals try to regain their composure after fleeing wildfires sweeping through southwest France.

data.title: Thai hairdressers: lives behind the scissors
data.description: “Neighbourhood barbershops and salons are becoming places only for people who are too lazy to wash their own hair or who have certain physical limitations. For example, they may have just undergone eye surgery,” 53-year-old hairdresser Nong says with a laugh.

data.title: Krabi Leads Thailand's Staycation Boom as Short Getaways Surge
data.description: Traveloka data reveals Thai holidaymakers are trading long annual trips for frequent weekend breaks, with coastal retreats in Krabi seeing bookings double

data.title: Thailand risks falling behind as global longevity race gathers pace
data.description: Thailand has medical tourism and genomic strengths but lacks a unified national strategy as other countries invest in healthier ageing

data.title: ONE Championship: Aliff has Prajanchai ‘in my sights’ as mind games begin after historic Sam-A KO
data.description: Aliff Sor Dechapan has warned Prajanchai PongSuphan PK that he is now firmly “in my sights” after finally forcing their long-simmering ONE Championship rivalry towards a title unification fight.

data.title: Thailand celebrates ninth World Heritage site
data.description: Thailand celebrated a major cultural milestone on Saturday as the Unesco World Heritage Committee approved the inscription of Wat Phra Mahathat Woramahawihan in Nakhon Si Thammarat as a World Cultural Heritage site.

data.title: Indian minister steps down over exam scandal
data.description: NEW ⁠DELHI - ​Indian Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned on Saturday, handing a major victory to youth protesters nationwide who had demanded that he quit to take responsibility for examination ​paper leaks.

data.title: Southern China braces for typhoon Noul
data.description: Strong ⁠winds and torrential rain ​lashed southern China on Saturday, brought by ​a strengthening typhoon Noul, ‌weather authorities said, urging people to avoid unnecessary travel as transport links could be disrupted.

data.title: UNESCO Names Nakhon Si Thammarat’s Wat Phra Mahathat a World Heritage Site
data.description: After 14 years on the tentative list, Wat Phra Mahathat becomes Southern Thailand's first UNESCO World Heritage site following a unanimous vote in Busan

data.title: Khlong Luang police chief transferred over alleged bribery
data.description: The chief of the Khlong Luang police station in Pathum Thani has been transferred to an inactive post pending an investigation after a recording purported to be of him soliciting bribes from the operator of a bar was circulated online.

data.title: Spain and France in grip of worst fires on record
data.description: Spain and France evacuated more than 160,000 people as out-of-control forest fires raged on Saturday near Madrid and Bordeaux, with the French army drafted in to help combat the worst wildfire the country has ever seen.

data.title: Italian embassy apologises for rowdy teens on BTS
data.description: The Embassy of Italy on Saturday apologised to the Thai people over “the inappropriate behaviour of a group of Italian underage tourists” on a BTS Skytrain in Bangkok that generated heated conversations online, while strongly condemning their actions.

data.title: C asean Presents 'ASEAN Connectivity Through Stories'
data.description: C asean invites literature, film, storytelling, and cross-cultural enthusiasts to take part in "ASEAN Connectivity Through Stories", an inspiring platform exploring the power of storytelling to foster understanding among people, societies, and cultures through insights and experiences shared by acclaimed authors, screenwriters, and a director.

data.title: Tyson Fury dominant in Pattaya tune-up fight
data.description: PATTAYA - Former ⁠world ⁠heavyweight champion ​Tyson Fury forced Polish ​opponent Mariusz ‌Wach to retire in a tune-up bout on Friday for a hoped-for showdown later this year with ​fellow ⁠Briton Anthony Joshua.

data.title: PM: Nation must set terms for detente with Cambodia
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has reaffirmed that Thailand is prepared to restore relations with Cambodia, but only under conditions that safeguard the country's national interests and sovereignty.

data.title: Dugong carcass found with tusks removed in Krabi
data.description: KRABI - Authorities are investigating the death of a dugong found stranded on a beach in this southern province after discovering that both of its tusks had been removed.

data.title: iLaw director undeterred by Bhumjaithai threats
data.description: ILaw director Yingcheep Atchanont has vowed to continue releasing evidence alleging manipulation of the 2024 Senate election, despite the ruling Bhumjaithai Party's threat to pursue legal action against him.

data.title: Elephant death investigation report disputed
data.description: Forestry officials are questioning the environment ministry's investigation into the death of the wild elephant Seedor Hu Pab, claiming that its conclusions contradict scientific findings previously reached by wildlife specialists.

data.title: Thailand DDC Issues Warning as Rainy Season Bacterial Infections Claim Over 100 Lives
data.description: Rising cases of leptospirosis and melioidosis prompt health officials to urge farmers and vulnerable groups to avoid wading in floodwater

data.title: Thailand Drives Kratom Towards Global Herbal Innovation Economy
data.description: Thailand is positioning kratom as a high-value medicinal plant through research, safety standards and global market development.

data.title: Fake coffee seized in B2.6m raid
data.description: Police have seized 226,720 counterfeit Nescafe, Ovaltine and Downy products worth 2.63 million baht after raiding two sites and arresting four suspects.

data.title: Linked databases eye traffic fine dodgers
data.description: The Ministry of Transport, the Department of Land Transport (DLT) and the Royal Thai Police will link their databases to strengthen enforcement against motorists who fail to pay traffic fines, with the measure applying only to tickets issued from Aug 1.

data.title: New pension formula promises fairer retirement benefits
data.description: The cabinet approved in principle the Career Average Revalued Earnings (Care) formula, a major reform of the Social Security pension system aimed at addressing long-standing complaints over unfair retirement benefits.

data.title: Government shifts gears
data.description: The Anutin Charnvirakul administration appears to be entering a new phase of governance — one marked less by headline-grabbing populist initiatives than by difficult policy recalibrations. Over the past few weeks, the government has quietly delayed, suspended or softened a number of high-profile initiatives, the latest being the Commerce Ministry’s proposed 40-baht curry rice scheme.

data.title: PP raises concerns over budget
data.description: People's Party (PP) deputy leader and list-MP Sirikanya Tansakun has raised concerns over unusually high and overlapping budget requests in the proposed 2027 fiscal budget, particularly for cloud services.

data.description: Forestry officials are questioning the environment ministry's investigation into the death of the wild elephant Seedor Hu Pab, claiming that its conclusions contradict scientific findings previously reached by wildlife specialists.

data.title: PP MP postpones grilling in forex case
data.description: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) yesterday granted a request by People's Party list-MP Pawoot Pongvitayapanu to postpone his first appearance for questioning in connection with an alleged foreign exchange investment scam.

data.title: Reclaiming autonomy
data.description: Thipyaporn Khempila was born blind. Diagnosed with glaucoma, she experienced complete loss of vision in her left eye and partial loss in her right eye.

data.title: Sounds Of Wireless gives young musicians a stage to grow
data.description: Presented by the Royal Bangkok Symphony Music School, Sounds Of Wireless, a monthly series transforms the open lobby of 140 Wireless into a performance space where young musicians can rehearse, perform before live audiences, showcase their abilities and gain professional experience.

data.title: Rockin' in the Free World
data.description: Last year, World Beat went to the annual Boon Phra Wet Festival in Roi Et City in Isan. The three-day event celebrated one of the monthly merit-making ceremonies -- heet sip song -- with parades, huge dance performances (10,101 dancers on the streets), Buddhist sermons and nightly molam stages for both popular and traditional artists and ensembles.
